content.text:
I'm mapping out the four corner quadrants of this 12x12 grid, identifying which specific cells in each corner hold value 1 or 2 based on their positions.

Now I'm computing the shift amounts needed to move each corner block toward the center, based on how far each block's max/min row and column extends. I apply these offsets to each corner's cells and assemble the full 12x12 grid row by row, placing the shifted values (1, 2, 4, or 8) into their new positions while leaving the rest as zeros.
